title_zh: AGY Roundtable v5.6.0 — 用户自主三档沙箱权限中心 · 跨目录授权 (--add-dir) · 单席权限与 R 崩溃弹窗根治
title_en: AGY Roundtable v5.6.0 — User-Controlled 3-Tier Sandbox Center, Extra Dir Grants (--add-dir), Per-Seat Permissions & Windows R Crash Fix
highlights_zh: 三档沙箱权限完全由用户自主选择：顶栏实时权限胶囊一键直达「沙箱与目录权限中心」，自由切换「🔒 只读 (read-only) / ✏️ 项目可写 (workspace-write) / ⚠️ 完全访问 (danger-full-access，默认安全锁定，需二次风险确认解锁且支持一键重新锁定回收)」
跨盘/外部数据目录授权（--add-dir）：支持直接点选或粘贴额外数据/代码目录（最多 8 个），Codex 与 Antigravity CLI 在 workspace-write 下无需放开整机权限即可跨目录读写
圆桌单席细粒度权限 + MCP 默认跟随：发起圆桌时可给每个参会席位单独切换只读/可写/完全访问（如审稿官保持只读、绘图/统计官可写），同时 MCP team_dispatch_task 自动跟随用户配置的默认沙箱
根治 Windows 下圆桌运行 Rscript/Rterm 0xc0000005 崩溃弹窗：进程树继承 Win32 SetErrorMode 彻底静默系统错误弹窗，并在只读沙箱下规避 R 4.5.2 受限令牌崩裂
highlights_en: User-controlled 3-tier sandbox permission center accessible from the topbar pill: freely switch between Read-Only (read-only), Workspace-Write (workspace-write), and Danger Full Access (danger-full-access, fail-closed by default, unlocked only via explicit 2-step risk confirmation and instantly relockable)

Cross-drive/external directory grants (--add-dir): visually pick or add up to 8 extra directories passed to Codex & Antigravity CLI so multi-folder datasets work cleanly inside workspace-write without full-machine access

Per-seat Roundtable permission overrides + MCP sync: set individual seat permissions (e.g., reviewer read-only, plotter writable) directly in the Roundtable composer, while MCP team_dispatch_task inherits user's default sandbox
Eliminates Windows Rterm.exe/Rscript.exe 0xc0000005 crash modals via inherited Win32 SetErrorMode and read-only sandbox guardrails
